properties.name: CHU abstract computational domain
properties.description: Broader project concept containing world-model and program/state profiles; not identical to any finite database or the physical universe.

properties.name: HSWM LLM-function AI profile
properties.description: One AI using LLM functions as basic cognitive operations and a persistent Semantic Weight hypergraph as state; can carry a world-model role.

properties.name: Illustrative numerical world-model profile
properties.description: A conceptual non-LLM simulator profile inside CHU. No simulator adapter or physical fidelity is asserted.

properties.name: World-modeling capability
properties.description: Capability shared as a declared modeling role; it is not disjoint from HSWM and its presence does not establish efficacy.

properties.name: Local LLM function kernel
properties.description: HSWM cognitive primitive: model/version-bound local LLM execution. Frozen parameter artifact, inference cache and long-term graph are distinct.

properties.name: Typed durable graph memory
properties.description: Existing canonical atom/revision storage is a bounded implementation connection, not the entire abstract CHU.

properties.name: Semantic program and ordered role bindings
properties.description: Stored meaning, roles, context, exceptions and evidence interpreted by local LLM; not arbitrary data evaluation.

properties.name: Kernel and realization contract
properties.description: Model-bound LLM runtime exists; a general numerical/rewrite kernel registry is still a design.

properties.name: Revision-bound execution and outcome
properties.description: Finite read/execute/outcome/revise/rebind path; general parallel scheduler not implemented.

properties.name: Versioned code and parameter artifact
properties.description: Content descriptors provide a connection; general ONNX/tensor or simulator import is not implemented.

properties.name: Derived document and model view
properties.description: Digest-bound exposed MapSpec fields and explicit projection loss; not a universal document compiler.

properties.name: Turing universal machine
properties.description: A machine description can be simulated; does not establish physical universality or CHU realization.
properties.claim_boundary: A machine description can be simulated; does not establish physical universality or CHU realization.

properties.name: EDVAC stored-program design
properties.description: Instruction/data memory and control are precedents, not equivalence to the proposed HSWM architecture.
properties.claim_boundary: Instruction/data memory and control are precedents, not equivalence to the proposed HSWM architecture.

properties.name: McCarthy symbolic expressions and evaluation
properties.description: Manipulable symbolic code requires evaluation semantics; stored data is not automatically executable.
properties.claim_boundary: Manipulable symbolic code requires evaluation semantics; stored data is not automatically executable.

properties.name: MeTTa fixed-revision comparator
properties.description: Metagraph programs and grounded functions; not proof of complete Hyperon or HSWM efficacy.

properties.name: ONNX model graph and tensor artifacts

properties.name: Transformers 5.7.0 inference cache
